title: uoa 에서요.
bodyHtml:
키를 잊어버려서 키를 다시 찾으려고 하니까

이런 메세지만 나오고 키가 안 나오네요 -_-

Locate result:
Account disabled. You must email Tugsoft and be sure to include your seed.UOAssist@tugsoft.com

Some 'hard' to see characters:  'l' = lower L '1'= numeric one 'I' = upper i

If after entering your key in UOAssist?/font> you get an error saying the key is corrupt it means some of the characters are being altered.  Be sure to use copy and paste to insure accuracy.  

Further questions can be sent toUOAssist@tugsoft.com.   Be sure to include your seed if you are looking for your key.


예전에도 키를 잊어버린적이 있어서 찾아보기를 안해본것도 아닌데

왜 지금은 안 찾아지는건지 -_- 쩝
